entry.confirm_signal: Two short beeps 2s after power-up, then the special tone 12321 5s later
steps: Switch the transmitter on; set the throttle to maximum
Wait 5000ms more: special tone 12321, programming mode entered

announce.description: 10 item tones loop: items 1-4 are 1-4 short beeps, items 5-9 are 1 long beep plus 0-4 short, item 10 is 2 long. After an item is entered its value tones loop, value N sounded the same way (values 1-8: 1-4 short, 1 long, 1 long plus 1-3 short). The manual: 'Usually, 1 long tone equals 5 short tones'.

select.description: Item: move the throttle to minimum after the desired item tone. The Chinese text gives 3s (3秒内); the English text gives no time for items 1-8, 5s for item 9 and both 3s and 5s for item 10.

value_select.description: Value: move the throttle to maximum after the desired value tone; special tone 1212 confirms the value is stored. The window length is not stated.

skip.description: Leave the throttle unchanged and wait for the next tone.

scheme.confirm_signal: Special tone (written 1212) after a value is stored.
scheme.exit: Item 10 (2 long beeps) then throttle to minimum within 3000ms: special tone 765765. Or, after a stored value, throttle to minimum within 3000ms. Or disconnect the battery.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Item 9 (1 long + 4 short beeps) 'Restore factory default': throttle to minimum within 5000ms, special tone 765765.
scheme.description: Throttle at maximum, then battery on. Two short beeps after 2s and the special tone 12321 after 5s more mark programming mode. The ESC loops 10 item tones; throttle to minimum on the desired item enters it. Value tones then loop; throttle to maximum on the desired tone stores it (tone 1212). Waiting returns to the item loop.

unknowns: The manual states no beep duration, gap between beeps or gap between groups. beep_ms and long_ms are measured (see notes). The gaps are read from one recording of 2026-11-11 (see notes) and are not stated in gap_ms or group_gap_ms.
Whether each item or value tone sounds once or several times before the next is not stated.
The window for the value move (throttle to maximum after a value tone) is not stated.
The window for the item move: the Chinese text gives 3s; the English item box gives no time.
Item 10 Exit: the English text of section 05 gives 5s, the English and Chinese menu boxes give 3s.
Whether the value loop starts at value 1 or at the stored value is not stated.
Whether the item loop restarts at item 1 or continues after a stored value is not stated, nor how long the ESC waits before it returns to the item loop.
Restore factory default sounds 765765, the same tone as Exit; whether the ESC stays in the menu afterwards is not stated.
The box 'If don't want select other parameter, move throttle to the zero position in 3 seconds' does not say from which tone the 3s count: the store tone 1212 or the next item tone.

Entry passes the throttle-range calibration's first step: the two short beeps at 2s mean 'full throttle position memorized' in section 04.2. Whether entering programming mode keeps that point is not stated.
Whether programming is entered the same way in running mode 2 (forward and reverse, neutral fixed at 1500us +-50us) is not stated.
BEC type (linear or switching) is not stated; the input voltage limit is not stated as a number.
notes: beep_ms 128 and long_ms 384 are measured on one FlyDragon Lite 40A (2-4S) at 7.6V over the phase tap on 2026-11-10: short beeps 127.9ms at 2090Hz, long beeps 383.7ms at 1866Hz, no beep lost. That recording gives no gaps. No FlyDragon Lite Plus is measured.

loop_marker is measured on one FlyDragon Lite 40A over the phase tap on 2026-11-11: the special tone 12321 (5 notes of 160ms at about 2090, 2343 and 2625Hz, no gap, about 808ms in all) sounds before every pass of the item loop, not only at entry. Item 10 (2 long beeps), 3.23s, the melody, 2.03s, item 1. Gaps inside a group are 146-150ms, gaps between item groups 3.23s. The value loops have no melody: a 3-value loop wrapped from 3 to 1. The Lite Plus manual does not mention the melody between passes; no FlyDragon Lite Plus is measured.

The manual is for the FlyDragon Lite Plus (Lite+) series. It states that, against the earlier FlyDragon Lite, the Plus adds the running modes (item 8). The menu of the earlier FlyDragon Lite is not in this manual: on it items 9 and 10 may sound one number lower.
v_max_mv is the cell count times 4.2V; the manual states cells (2-4S, 3-6S), not a voltage.
Battery type value 2 is written 'NiCb/NiMh' in the English text; the Chinese text gives 镍氢/镍镉 (NiMH/NiCd).
Low voltage threshold default: medium, 3.0V per LiPo cell, 65% of the Ni pack's start voltage. The manual's 4S example: 11.2V low, 12.0V medium, 12.8V high.
Timing: the English text lists 'Low (0/3.75/11.25/15/18.75deg)' for inner rotor motors and 'High (22.5/26.25deg)' for 6-pole and higher outer rotor motors; 7.5deg is in neither list.
Startup mode values: normal has no latency from 0% to 100% throttle, soft takes 6s, very soft 12s.
Voltage cutoff option: the Chinese text names the values 软关断 (soft cutoff, default) and 硬关断 (hard cutoff).
Running mode 2 (forward and reverse): the motor reverses when it has stopped; maximum and minimum throttle can be calibrated, neutral is fixed at 1500us +-50us.
Trouble shooting: 2 long and 2 short beeps after power-up mean the throttle channel is reversed and the ESC entered programming mode.
The table header reads 'Restore factory defaule'; section 05 names the item 'Restore default settings'.
